---
title: "01. Clean, classify applicants, deduplicate to institutions, build panel"
author: "Sonali Singh"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    code_folding: show
params:
  extract_date: "2025-08-15"   # date of the IPO extract
  year_min: 2005
  year_max: 2024
  nirf_year: 2015              # first exposed filing year; 2014 is the base year
  fee_year: 2021               # fee cut 21 Sep 2021 (descriptive only)
---

Inputs: the three IP India search exports (`data-raw/`, fetched by `data-raw/download.R`). Outputs in `data/`: an application table, a unit (institution) attribute table and a balanced institution-year panel with the treatment dummies. Outputs in `output/review/`: tables for checking the classification and the institution clusters by hand. No estimation here.

Pipeline: load -\> stack and deduplicate applications -\> dates -\> normalise applicant names -\> classify names (modal class per name) -\> collapse names to institutions -\> review tables -\> unit attributes -\> panel.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here); library(data.table); library(stringr); library(lubridate); library(knitr)
})
setDTthreads(0)
source(here("data-raw", "download.R"))
dir.create(here("data"), showWarnings = FALSE); dir.create(here("output", "review"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

extract_d <- as.Date(params$extract_date)
pub_complete_year <- year(extract_d) - 2L    # 18-month publication lag: last filing year fully observed
nirf_year <- as.integer(params$nirf_year); fee_year <- as.integer(params$fee_year)
YEARS <- seq(params$year_min, params$year_max)

f_pub <- here("data-raw", "IPR_published.csv.gz")
f_gr  <- here("data-raw", "IPR_granted.csv.gz")
f_er  <- here("data-raw", "IPR_granted_er_as.csv.gz")

snake <- function(x) { x <- tolower(x); x <- gsub("\\(ipc\\)", "ipc", x); x <- gsub("u/s 11a", "us11a", x)
  x <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", x); gsub("^_|_$", "", x) }
mode_chr <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]; if (!length(x)) return(NA_character_); names(which.max(table(x))) }
```

# 1. Load

Only the columns the panel needs. Everything is read as character; dates are parsed in section 3.

```{r load}
core_cols <- c("Application Number", "Publication Date", "Application Filing Date", "Priority Country",
               "Priority Date", "Field Of Invention", "Classification (IPC)", "Invention Title")
app_cols <- as.vector(outer(paste0("Applicant", 1:3), c("Name", "State", "Country"), paste, sep = " "))
inv_cols <- paste0("Inventor", 1:10, " Name")
er_cols  <- c("ER-Legal Status", "ER-Date of Grant", "ER-Date of Patent", "ER-Due Date of Next Renewal",
              "ER-Type of Application", "ER-Grantee1 Grantee Type")
as_cols  <- c("AS-Request For Examination Date", "AS-First Examination Report Date", "AS-Reply To Fer Date",
              "AS-Date Of Certificate Issue")
na_str <- c("", "NA", "NaN", "nan", "None", "NULL", "---")
read_ipr <- function(path, cols) {
  hdr <- names(fread(path, nrows = 0))
  fread(path, select = intersect(cols, hdr), colClasses = "character", na.strings = na_str,
        encoding = "UTF-8", strip.white = TRUE, showProgress = FALSE)
}
pub <- read_ipr(f_pub, c(core_cols, app_cols, inv_cols))
gr  <- read_ipr(f_gr,  c(core_cols, app_cols, inv_cols))
er  <- read_ipr(f_er,  c("Application Number", er_cols, as_cols))
for (d in list(pub, gr, er)) setnames(d, snake(names(d)))
cat("rows read: published", nrow(pub), "| granted", nrow(gr), "| ER/AS", nrow(er), "\n")
```

# 2. One row per application

An application is granted if its number appears in the granted file. Where both files carry it, the granted row is kept. E-register and status fields exist for granted applications only, so refusals and abandonments are not observed: the data distinguish granted from published-not-(yet)-granted, nothing finer.

```{r stack}
pub[, src := "published"]; gr[, src := "granted"]
gr_ids <- unique(gr$application_number)
qc_overlap <- data.table(published = nrow(pub), granted = nrow(gr),
  granted_also_in_published = sum(gr_ids %in% pub$application_number),
  dup_in_published = sum(duplicated(pub$application_number)), dup_in_granted = sum(duplicated(gr$application_number)),
  er_rows = nrow(er), er_in_granted = sum(unique(er$application_number) %in% gr_ids))
kable(t(qc_overlap), col.names = "n")

apps <- rbindlist(list(gr, pub), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)[!is.na(application_number)]
setorder(apps, application_number, src)                 # "granted" < "published": granted row wins
apps <- unique(apps, by = "application_number")
apps[, granted := application_number %in% gr_ids]
apps <- merge(apps, unique(er[!is.na(application_number)], by = "application_number"), by = "application_number", all.x = TRUE)
rm(pub, gr, er); invisible(gc())
cat("applications:", nrow(apps), "| granted:", sum(apps$granted), "\n")
```

# 3. Dates and derived timing

The extract mixes `dd/mm/yyyy` and ISO `yyyy-mm-dd`; both are parsed. The slot check below must show `second_gt12` near 0 (otherwise the day/month order is wrong).

```{r dates}
parse_ipo <- function(x) as.Date(parse_date_time(x, orders = c("Ymd", "dmY", "dmy"), quiet = TRUE))
date_cols <- c("application_filing_date", "publication_date", "priority_date", "er_date_of_grant", "er_date_of_patent",
               "er_due_date_of_next_renewal", "as_request_for_examination_date", "as_first_examination_report_date",
               "as_reply_to_fer_date", "as_date_of_certificate_issue")
date_cols <- intersect(date_cols, names(apps))
slot_check <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & grepl("/", x, fixed = TRUE)]
  if (!length(x)) return(list(first_gt12 = NA_real_, second_gt12 = NA_real_))
  p <- tstrsplit(x, "/", fixed = TRUE)
  list(first_gt12 = mean(suppressWarnings(as.integer(p[[1]])) > 12, na.rm = TRUE),
       second_gt12 = mean(suppressWarnings(as.integer(p[[2]])) > 12, na.rm = TRUE))
}
for (v in date_cols) {
  d <- parse_ipo(apps[[v]])
  if (v != "er_due_date_of_next_renewal") d[!is.na(d) & (d <= as.Date("1900-01-01") | d > extract_d)] <- NA
  set(apps, j = paste0(v, "_d"), value = d)
}
qc_dates <- rbindlist(lapply(date_cols, function(v) {
  raw <- apps[[v]]; d <- apps[[paste0(v, "_d")]]
  c(list(col = v, nonmissing = sum(!is.na(raw)), parsed = sum(!is.na(d)), fail_rate = round(mean(is.na(d[!is.na(raw)])), 4)),
    slot_check(raw), list(min = min(d, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(d, na.rm = TRUE)))
}))
kable(qc_dates, digits = 4)

apps[, filing_date := application_filing_date_d]
apps[, filing_year := year(filing_date)]
apps[, grant_date  := er_date_of_grant_d]
apps[, pub_lag_days   := as.integer(publication_date_d - filing_date)]
apps[, grant_lag_days := as.integer(grant_date - filing_date)]
apps[, granted_within_4y := granted & !is.na(grant_lag_days) & grant_lag_days <= 4 * 365.25]
apps[, g4_observable := filing_date <= extract_d - 4 * 365.25]        # cohorts with 4 full years of exposure
apps[, no_priority := is.na(priority_date_d) & is.na(priority_country)]
apps[, early_pub   := no_priority & !is.na(pub_lag_days) & pub_lag_days <= 365]   # Form 9 proxy (standard is 18 months)
apps[, lapsed := granted & !is.na(er_legal_status) & er_legal_status %chin% c("Ceased", "Under Extension Period")]
apps[, post_fee_date := !is.na(filing_date) & filing_date >= as.Date("2021-09-21")]
apps[, n_inventors := rowSums(!is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = patterns("^inventor[0-9]+_name$")]
apps[, n_applicants := rowSums(!is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = patterns("^applicant[0-9]+_name$")]
apps[, ipc_section := toupper(substr(str_trim(classification_ipc), 1, 1))]
apps[!ipc_section %chin% LETTERS[1:8], ipc_section := NA_character_]
```

# 4. Applicant names

Normalisation: upper case, punctuation to spaces, drop articles and corporate suffixes, squeeze spaces. `entity` is the normalised first-applicant name. Domestic = first applicant's country is India.

```{r names}
norm_name <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "[^A-Z0-9 ]", " ")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\b(THE|M S|MESSRS|LTD|LIMITED|PVT|PRIVATE|INC|LLC|LLP|CO|COMPANY|CORP|CORPORATION)\\b", " ")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, c("\\bPROFESIONAL\\b" = "PROFESSIONAL", "\\bUNIVERSTIY\\b" = "UNIVERSITY", "\\bUNIVERISTY\\b" = "UNIVERSITY",
                            "\\bUNIVESITY\\b" = "UNIVERSITY", "\\bINSTITITE\\b" = "INSTITUTE", "\\bINSTITUE\\b" = "INSTITUTE",
                            "\\bENGINEERNG\\b" = "ENGINEERING", "\\bENGG\\b" = "ENGINEERING", "\\bTECH\\b" = "TECHNOLOGY"))
  str_squish(x)
}
apps[, entity := norm_name(applicant1_name)]
apps[entity == "", entity := NA_character_]
apps[, app1_state := str_squish(toupper(applicant1_state))]
apps[, domestic := !is.na(applicant1_country) & applicant1_country == "India"]
cat("domestic applications:", sum(apps$domestic), "| distinct domestic first-applicant names:", uniqueN(apps[domestic == TRUE, entity]), "\n")
```

# 5. Classification

Two layers. First every first-applicant name gets a **sector** by regex, with precedence incubator \> education \> government lab / PSU \> firm \> individual, and then its modal sector across its applications (a name is never dropped for carrying two sectors; `class_conflict` flags the ones that did).

Second, educational names get a **tier** and an **ownership**:

Ownership has three values: `central` (centrally funded: the INI families, central universities and central institutes), `state` (state-funded) and `private`. Where an institution is matched to the UGC consolidated list of universities (`R/ugc_match.csv`, hand-checked matches), the UGC type sets ownership; the pattern file overrides it only for publicly run deemed universities (IISc, TIFR, ISI, ...). The `elite` flag is pre-treatment research capacity, independent of ownership:

-   `elite`: any institution in the SCImago Institutions Ranking 2010 for India (97 research universities and institutes, public and private alike: `R/institution_patterns.csv`, source `scimago2010`), plus the Institutes of National Importance families that the list only samples (IIT, NIT, IIIT, IISER, IIM, AIIMS), central universities, and the manual additions in the same file (DTU, NSUT, VNIT). Elite is a research-capacity tier measured before the shock, not an ownership class.
-   `state` ownership: "Government", state acts, agricultural, technological, open and health universities, the named public list, and any "University of <state or city>" / "<state or city> University" not caught as central.
-   `private` ownership: everything else: universities, deemed universities, institutes, colleges, schools and polytechnics. Affiliated engineering, pharmacy, management and medical colleges are privately owned in nearly every case (hand-checked on the full data, 5 Nov 2026), so they sit here.

`tier` combines the two for labelling: `elite`, else the ownership (`central`, `state`, `private`).

So the panel can be cut four ways: universities vs firms; by ownership (central / state / private); by capacity (elite / non-elite); and their interaction. Government labs and PSUs (`govt_lab_psu`) stay in the panel as a second control group: publicly funded, never ranked.

  "THANJAVUR","TIRUNELVELI","CALICUT","COCHIN","KANNUR","KOTTAYAM","TRIVANDRUM","VISAKHAPATNAM","GUNTUR","TIRUPATI","KAKATIYA",

```{r classify}
rx_suffix <- "\\b(LTD|LIMITED|PVT|PRIVATE|INC|LLC|LLP|CORP|CORPORATION|COMPANY|CO)\\b"
apps[, raw_up := str_replace_all(toupper(applicant1_name), "[^A-Z0-9 ]", " ")]
apps[, has_suffix := str_detect(raw_up, rx_suffix)]
rx_govt_strong <- paste("COUNCIL OF SCIENTIFIC", "\\bCSIR\\b", "DEFENCE RESEARCH", "\\bDRDO\\b", "INDIAN COUNCIL OF", "\\bICAR\\b", "\\bICMR\\b",
  "MINISTRY OF", "GOVERNMENT OF INDIA", "PRESIDENT OF INDIA", "SECRETARY", "DIRECTOR GENERAL", "BHABHA ATOMIC", "INDIAN SPACE", "\\bISRO\\b",
  "NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF OCEAN", "NATIONAL .* LABORATORY", "CENTRAL .* RESEARCH INSTITUTE", "\\bNRDC\\b", "\\bC DAC\\b", "\\bCDAC\\b", sep = "|")
sector_row <- function(nm, has_suffix) {
  fcase(is.na(nm),                                   NA_character_,
        str_detect(nm, rx_incubator),                "incubator",
        str_detect(nm, rx_govt_strong),              "govt_lab_psu",
        str_detect(nm, rx_edu),                      "edu",
        str_detect(nm, rx_govt_lab),                 "govt_lab_psu",
        has_suffix | str_detect(nm, rx_firm),        "firm",
        default = "individual_other")
}
apps[, sector_row := sector_row(entity, has_suffix)]
sec_tab <- apps[!is.na(entity), .N, by = .(entity, sector_row)]
setorder(sec_tab, entity, -N, sector_row)
sec_name <- sec_tab[, .(sector = sector_row[1], n_sectors = .N), by = entity]
apps <- merge(apps, sec_name, by = "entity", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
apps[, class_conflict := !is.na(n_sectors) & n_sectors > 1]
apps[, edu := !is.na(sector) & sector == "edu"]
kable(apps[domestic == TRUE, .N, by = sector][order(-N)], caption = "Domestic applications by sector (modal sector per name)")
```

# 6. Educational names: pattern file, tier, ownership, institution id

The institution id is built in this order, first hit wins:

1.  `R/institution_overrides.csv` (hand decisions);
2.  `R/institution_patterns.csv`: one regex per known institution, all campuses and spellings mapped to one id (the SCImago 2010 list, plus multi-campus private groups like Amity, VIT, SRM, Manipal, UPES, Graphic Era, and the big affiliated colleges); a hit also fixes tier (elite) and ownership;
3.  the IIT / NIT / IIIT / IISER / IIM / AIIMS families, keyed on campus (each campus has its own board, so each is a unit);
4.  a canonical name: prefix and deemed-suffix removal, "University of X" and "X University" folded together, up to two trailing place words dropped, never below three words, generic names never merged.

Tier and ownership then follow section 5. Names that fit nothing but the generic rules are the ones to look at in `review_edu_unmatched.csv`.

```{r institutions}
PREFIX_RX <- "^(THE REGISTRAR|REGISTRAR|DIRECTOR|PRINCIPAL|DEAN|VICE CHANCELLOR|CHANCELLOR|DEPARTMENT OF [A-Z ]+?|DEPT OF [A-Z ]+?|SCHOOL OF [A-Z ]+?|CENTRE FOR [A-Z ]+?|CENTER FOR [A-Z ]+?|FACULTY OF [A-Z ]+?)\\s+(?=[A-Z])"
CAMPUS <- unique(c("BOMBAY","DELHI","MADRAS","KANPUR","KHARAGPUR","ROORKEE","GUWAHATI","HYDERABAD","INDORE","MANDI","ROPAR","PATNA",
  "GANDHINAGAR","JODHPUR","BHUBANESWAR","VARANASI","BHU","DHANBAD","ISM","TIRUPATI","PALAKKAD","JAMMU","DHARWAD","BHILAI","GOA",
  "TIRUCHIRAPPALLI","TRICHY","WARANGAL","SURATHKAL","KARNATAKA","CALICUT","ROURKELA","DURGAPUR","SILCHAR","KURUKSHETRA","JAIPUR",
  "ALLAHABAD","BHOPAL","NAGPUR","SURAT","HAMIRPUR","SRINAGAR","JALANDHAR","AGARTALA","RAIPUR","UTTARAKHAND","PUNE","KOLKATA",
  "MOHALI","THIRUVANANTHAPURAM","TIRUVANANTHAPURAM","BERHAMPUR","BANGALORE","BENGALURU","GWALIOR","JABALPUR","KANCHEEPURAM",
  "SRI CITY","KOTA","LUCKNOW","KOTTAYAM","RANCHI","SONEPAT","UNA","VADODARA","KALYANI","BHAGALPUR","AHMEDABAD","CALCUTTA",
  "KOZHIKODE","SHILLONG","UDAIPUR","KASHIPUR","VISAKHAPATNAM","AMRITSAR","BODH GAYA","SAMBALPUR","SIRMAUR","MEGHALAYA","MANIPUR",
  "MIZORAM","NAGALAND","SIKKIM","ARUNACHAL","PUDUCHERRY","RISHIKESH","RAEBARELI","BIBINAGAR","MANGALAGIRI","BATHINDA","DEOGHAR",
  "GORAKHPUR","BILASPUR","RAJKOT","MADURAI","VIJAYPUR","KURNOOL","TRIVANDRUM","TIRUCHIRAPALLI","NAGPUR"))
CITIES <- unique(c(CAMPUS, PLACES, "NOIDA","GREATER","GURGAON","GURUGRAM","PHAGWARA","PRADESH","UTTAR","MADHYA","BENGAL","WEST","NCR",
  "INDIA","GHAZIABAD","FARIDABAD","MATHURA","MORADABAD","ALIGARH","ERODE","KANCHIPURAM","CHENGALPATTU","VIJAYAWADA","NELLORE",
  "SECUNDERABAD","HUBLI","BELGAUM","BELAGAVI","UDUPI","MANIPAL","KOCHI","ERNAKULAM","THRISSUR","KOLLAM","NASHIK","NASIK","SANGLI",
  "SATARA","AKOLA","WARDHA","THANE","NAVI","ANAND","VALLABH","VIDYANAGAR","JAMNAGAR","MEHSANA","SIKAR","ALWAR","BHILWARA","UJJAIN",
  "SATNA","CUTTACK","SILIGURI","HOWRAH","HOOGHLY","NADIA","BARASAT","ASANSOL","HALDIA","KANGRA","SIRMOUR","KARNAL","PANIPAT",
  "SONIPAT","RUPNAGAR","PANCHKULA","HARIDWAR","PANTNAGAR","KATHUA","GANGTOK","IMPHAL","AIZAWL","KOHIMA","ITANAGAR","JORHAT",
  "BOKARO","DURG","CAMPUS","CITY","TOWN","DISTRICT","DIST","PO","PS","TALUK","ROAD","NH"))
GENERIC <- c("UNIVERSITY","INSTITUTE","COLLEGE","INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY","COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING","ENGINEERING COLLEGE",
  "INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY","INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY AND MANAGEMENT","COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY",
  "INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT","INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY","COLLEGE OF PHARMACY","MEDICAL COLLEGE","INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES",
  "SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING","INSTITUTE OF PHARMACY","INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES","DENTAL COLLEGE","COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING AND MANAGEMENT")
INST_RX <- "^(.*?)\\b(INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY|NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY|INDIAN INSTITUTE OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY|INDIAN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE EDUCATION AND RESEARCH|INDIAN INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT|ALL INDIA INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES)\\b(.*)$"

strip_prefix <- function(e) str_squish(str_replace(e, PREFIX_RX, ""))
campus_key <- function(e) {
  s <- strip_prefix(e); m <- str_match(s, INST_RX)
  if (is.na(m[1, 1])) return(NA_character_)
  # campus word: look after the institute name first (IIT DELHI), then before it (MALAVIYA NIT JAIPUR has it after; DR B R AMBEDKAR NIT JALANDHAR too)
  rest <- c(str_split(str_squish(m[1, 4]), " ")[[1]], rev(str_split(str_squish(m[1, 2]), " ")[[1]]))
  rest <- rest[nzchar(rest) & !rest %chin% c("OF", "THE", "AND", "DR") & !str_starts(rest, "IIT|NIT|IIIT|IISER|AIIMS|IIM")]
  key <- "UNSPECIFIED"
  named <- c("MALAVIYA" = "JAIPUR", "AMBEDKAR" = "JALANDHAR", "VALLABHBHAI" = "SURAT", "MOTILAL" = "ALLAHABAD", "MAULANA" = "BHOPAL",
             "VISVESVARAYA" = "NAGPUR", "BHU" = "VARANASI", "ISM" = "DHANBAD")   # named NITs / IITs whose city is often omitted
  for (w in names(named)) if (str_detect(s, paste0("\\b", w, "\\b"))) { key <- named[[w]]; break }
  if (key == "UNSPECIFIED") for (w in rest) {
    d <- adist(w, CAMPUS) / pmax(nchar(w), nchar(CAMPUS))
    if (min(d) <= 0.2 && nchar(w) >= 4) { key <- CAMPUS[which.min(d)]; break }
  }
  paste0("CK_", m[1, 3], "_", key)
}
canon_name <- function(e) {
  s <- strip_prefix(e)
  s <- str_replace_all(s, "\\b(DEEMED TO BE UNIVERSITY|DEEMED UNIVERSITY|DEEMED TO BE A UNIVERSITY)\\b", "UNIVERSITY")
  s <- str_replace_all(s, "\\b(DEEMED TO BE|DEEMED|A CENTRAL UNIVERSITY|A STATE UNIVERSITY|AN AUTONOMOUS INSTITUTE|AUTONOMOUS)\\b", " ")
  s <- str_replace(s, "\\b(FORMERLY|ERSTWHILE|EARLIER) (KNOWN AS )?.*$", " ")
  s <- str_squish(s)
  m <- str_match(s, "^UNIVERSITY OF ([A-Z]+)$"); if (!is.na(m[1, 2])) s <- paste(m[1, 2], "UNIVERSITY")   # University of X == X University
  toks <- str_split(s, " ")[[1]]; k <- 0L
  while (length(toks) > 3 && k < 2L && (toks[length(toks)] %chin% CITIES || grepl("^[0-9]+$", toks[length(toks)]))) {
    toks <- toks[-length(toks)]; k <- k + 1L
  }
  s <- paste(toks, collapse = " ")
  if (s %chin% GENERIC || nchar(s) < 8) s <- e
  paste0("NM_", s)
}

edu_names <- unique(apps[domestic == TRUE & edu == TRUE & !is.na(entity), entity])
inst_map <- data.table(entity = edu_names)
inst_map[, stripped := vapply(entity, strip_prefix, character(1))]

# 1. overrides
ov_path <- here("R", "institution_overrides.csv")
if (!file.exists(ov_path)) fwrite(data.table(entity = character(), inst_id = character(), tier_override = character(),
                                             ownership_override = character(), note = character()), ov_path)
ov <- fread(ov_path, colClasses = "character")[entity != ""]
for (v in c("inst_id", "tier_override", "ownership_override")) if (!v %chin% names(ov)) ov[, (v) := NA_character_]
inst_map <- merge(inst_map, ov[, .(entity, ov_id = inst_id, tier_override, ownership_override)], by = "entity", all.x = TRUE)
inst_map[, inst_id := fifelse(!is.na(ov_id) & ov_id != "", paste0("OV_", ov_id), NA_character_)]

# 2. pattern file (first matching row wins; elite rows come first)
pat <- fread(here("R", "institution_patterns.csv"), colClasses = "character")
inst_map[, `:=`(pat_id = NA_character_, pat_tier = NA_character_, pat_own = NA_character_)]
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pat))) {
  hit <- is.na(inst_map$pat_id) & str_detect(inst_map$stripped, pat$regex[i])
  if (any(hit)) inst_map[hit, `:=`(pat_id = pat$inst_id[i], pat_tier = pat$tier[i], pat_own = pat$ownership[i])]
}
inst_map[is.na(inst_id) & !is.na(pat_id), inst_id := pat_id]
# 3. INI campus key, 4. canonical name
inst_map[is.na(inst_id), inst_id := vapply(entity, campus_key, character(1))]
inst_map[is.na(inst_id), inst_id := vapply(entity, canon_name, character(1))]

# UGC list of universities (R/ugc_match.csv: institution ids matched by hand to the UGC consolidated list; use_ugc = accepted match).
# UGC type gives ownership directly: Central / State / Private; "Deemed to be" universities are private unless the pattern file says otherwise.
ugc_path <- here("R", "ugc_match.csv")
if (file.exists(ugc_path)) {
  ugc <- fread(ugc_path, colClasses = "character")[tolower(use_ugc) %chin% c("true", "1", "yes")]
  ugc[, ugc_own := fcase(ugc_type == "Central", "central", ugc_type == "State", "state", rep(TRUE, .N), "private")]
  inst_map <- merge(inst_map, unique(ugc[, .(inst_id, ugc_own, ugc_type)], by = "inst_id"), by = "inst_id", all.x = TRUE)
} else inst_map[, `:=`(ugc_own = NA_character_, ugc_type = NA_character_)]

# tier and ownership
inst_map[, is_ini := str_detect(stripped, rx_ini)]
inst_map[, is_elite := (!is.na(pat_tier) & pat_tier == "elite") | is_ini]
rx_central <- paste("CENTRAL UNIVERSITY", "CENTRAL AGRICULTURAL", "CENTRAL INSTITUTE", "CENTRAL SANSKRIT", "RASHTRIYA SANSKRIT", "NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF (DESIGN|FASHION|TECHNICAL TEACHERS|FOUNDRY)",
                     "INDIAN INSTITUTE OF (SCIENCE|ENGINEERING SCIENCE|SPACE|PETROLEUM|FOREIGN TRADE|TEACHER)", "NATIONAL LAW UNIVERSITY DELHI", "ENGLISH AND FOREIGN LANGUAGES",
                     "INDIRA GANDHI NATIONAL", "NATIONAL DAIRY RESEARCH", "SANT LONGOWAL", "ATAL BIHARI VAJPAYEE INDIAN INSTITUTE", "\\bABV IIITM\\b", "RAJIV GANDHI INSTITUTE OF PETROLEUM",
                     "NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL", "INDIAN MARITIME", "FOOTWEAR DESIGN", "SCHOOL OF PLANNING AND ARCHITECTURE", sep = "|")
inst_map[, ownership := fcase(!is.na(pat_own) & pat_own != "", pat_own,
                              !is.na(ugc_own),                       ugc_own,
                              is_ini,                                "central",
                              str_detect(stripped, rx_central),      "central",
                              str_detect(stripped, rx_public),       "state",
                              str_detect(stripped, rx_private),      "private",
                              str_detect(stripped, rx_place_univ),   "state",
                              rep(TRUE, .N),                         "private")]   # unlisted universities, institutes and colleges
# tier = elite (SIR 2010 / INI, any ownership) or, for the rest, the ownership; `elite` kept as its own flag
inst_map[, tier := fifelse(is_elite, "elite", ownership)]   # reviewed 5 Nov: schools, polytechnics, colleges all private
inst_map[!is.na(tier_override) & tier_override != "", tier := tier_override]
inst_map[!is.na(ownership_override) & ownership_override != "", ownership := ownership_override]
inst_map[, matched_by := fcase(!is.na(ov_id) & ov_id != "", "override", !is.na(pat_id), "pattern file", str_starts(inst_id, "CK_"), "campus key",
                               rep(TRUE, .N), "canonical name")]
inst_map[, ownership_source := fcase(!is.na(ownership_override) & ownership_override != "", "override", !is.na(pat_own) & pat_own != "", "pattern file",
                                     !is.na(ugc_own), "UGC list", rep(TRUE, .N), "name rule")]
inst_map[, elite := as.integer(is_elite)]
inst_map[, class_name := paste0("edu_", tier)]

apps <- merge(apps, inst_map[, .(entity, inst_id, tier, ownership, elite, class_name, matched_by)], by = "entity", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
apps[is.na(inst_id) & !is.na(entity), `:=`(inst_id = entity, class_name = sector)]   # non-education: one unit per name
apps[is.na(ownership), ownership := fifelse(sector == "firm", "firm", sector)]
apps[is.na(tier), tier := ownership]
apps[is.na(elite), elite := 0L]
# the institution's tier / ownership is that of its largest name
inst_cls <- apps[domestic == TRUE & !is.na(inst_id), .N, by = .(inst_id, class_name, tier, ownership, elite)][order(inst_id, -N)][
  , .(class = class_name[1], inst_tier = tier[1], inst_ownership = ownership[1], inst_elite = elite[1]), by = inst_id]
apps <- merge(apps, inst_cls, by = "inst_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

cat("domestic educational names:", length(edu_names), "-> institutions:", uniqueN(inst_map$inst_id),
    "| names in multi-name institutions:", inst_map[, .N, by = inst_id][N > 1, sum(N)], "\n")
kable(inst_map[, .(names = .N, institutions = uniqueN(inst_id)), by = .(elite, ownership)][order(-elite, ownership)])
kable(inst_map[, .N, by = matched_by][order(-N)])
kable(inst_map[, .(names = .N, institutions = uniqueN(inst_id)), by = ownership_source][order(-names)], caption = "Where ownership came from")
if (file.exists(ugc_path)) kable(dcast(inst_map[!is.na(ugc_type), .N, by = .(ugc_type, ownership)], ugc_type ~ ownership, value.var = "N", fill = 0L),
                                 caption = "UGC type vs final ownership (pattern-file ownership wins for deemed universities that are publicly run)")
```

# 7. Review tables (hand verification)

Written to `output/review/`. Decisions go in `R/institution_overrides.csv` (columns `entity`, `inst_id`, `tier_override`, `ownership_override`, `note`) or as new rows in `R/institution_patterns.csv`; re-knit and they apply.

-   `review_top_names_by_class.csv`: the 100 largest domestic names per class.
-   `review_elite.csv`: every name in the elite tier with what matched it.
-   `review_state.csv`: every name in the state tier (public, not elite).
-   `review_edu_unmatched.csv`: educational names that hit neither the pattern file nor the campus key, largest first: these were classified by generic words only, so they are where the errors are.
-   `review_class_conflicts.csv`: names whose rows disagreed on sector.
-   `review_multi_name_institutions.csv`: institutions that absorbed more than one name.
-   `review_singleton_edu_names.csv`: names sharing a three-word stem with another unit.
-   `validation_sample.csv`: 50 random applications per class, pre and post 2015, blank `true_class`.

```{r review}
dom <- apps[domestic == TRUE & !is.na(entity)]
by_name <- dom[, .(n_apps = .N, first_year = min(filing_year, na.rm = TRUE), last_year = max(filing_year, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_states = uniqueN(app1_state), state = mode_chr(app1_state), example_raw = applicant1_name[1]),
               by = .(class_name, tier, ownership, matched_by, entity, inst_id)]
fwrite(by_name[order(class_name, -n_apps), head(.SD, 100), by = class_name], here("output", "review", "review_top_names_by_class.csv"))
fwrite(by_name[tier == "elite"][order(inst_id, -n_apps)], here("output", "review", "review_elite.csv"))
fwrite(by_name[tier == "state"][order(inst_id, -n_apps)], here("output", "review", "review_state.csv"))
fwrite(by_name[entity %chin% edu_names & matched_by == "canonical name"][order(-n_apps)], here("output", "review", "review_edu_unmatched.csv"))
conf <- sec_tab[entity %chin% dom[class_conflict == TRUE, unique(entity)]]
conf <- dcast(conf, entity ~ sector_row, value.var = "N", fill = 0L)
fwrite(merge(conf, sec_name[, .(entity, sector)], by = "entity")[order(sector)], here("output", "review", "review_class_conflicts.csv"))
multi <- by_name[entity %chin% edu_names][, if (.N > 1) .SD, by = inst_id]
fwrite(multi[order(inst_id, -n_apps)], here("output", "review", "review_multi_name_institutions.csv"))
single <- by_name[entity %chin% edu_names]; single[, stem := word(entity, 1, 3)]
fwrite(single[, if (uniqueN(inst_id) > 1) .SD, by = stem][order(stem, -n_apps)], here("output", "review", "review_singleton_edu_names.csv"))
set.seed(20261105)
val <- dom[!is.na(filing_year) & filing_year >= 2005,
           .SD[sample(.N, min(.N, 50))], by = .(class_name, post = filing_year >= nirf_year),
           .SDcols = c("application_number", "applicant1_name", "applicant1_state", "filing_year", "inst_id")]
val[, true_class := ""]
fwrite(val[order(class_name, post)], here("output", "review", "validation_sample.csv"))

kable(by_name[entity %chin% edu_names][order(-n_apps)][1:30, .(class_name, entity, inst_id, matched_by, n_apps)], caption = "30 largest domestic educational names")
kable(multi[, .N, by = inst_id][order(-N)][1:15], caption = "Institutions absorbing the most names")
```

# 8. Truncation

```{r truncation}
qc_lag <- apps[granted & !is.na(grant_lag_days) & filing_year >= 2005,
  .(n_granted = .N, p50_years = quantile(grant_lag_days, .5) / 365.25, p90_years = quantile(grant_lag_days, .9) / 365.25,
    max_possible = as.numeric(extract_d - as.Date(paste0(filing_year[1], "-07-01"))) / 365.25), by = filing_year][order(filing_year)]
grant_safe_max_year <- qc_lag[p90_years < max_possible - 1, max(filing_year)]
kable(qc_lag, digits = 2)
cat("grant outcomes usable through filing year:", grant_safe_max_year, "| filing counts complete through:", pub_complete_year, "\n")
```

# 9. Unit attributes

One row per institution. Startups (IPO grantee type STARTUP on any granted application) are flagged so firm controls can exclude them.

```{r units}
ut <- apps[domestic == TRUE & !is.na(inst_id),
  .(class = class[1], tier = inst_tier[1], ownership = inst_ownership[1], elite = inst_elite[1], n_names = uniqueN(entity), main_name = mode_chr(entity),
    state = mode_chr(app1_state), first_filing_year = min(filing_year, na.rm = TRUE), n_filings_ever = .N, n_granted_ever = sum(granted),
    grantee_type = mode_chr(er_grantee1_grantee_type), class_conflict_any = any(class_conflict)),
  by = inst_id]
ut[, startup := !is.na(grantee_type) & str_detect(toupper(grantee_type), "START")]
ut[class == "govt_lab_psu", `:=`(tier = "govt_lab", ownership = "govt_lab", elite = 0L)]
ut[class == "firm", `:=`(tier = "firm", ownership = "firm", elite = 0L)]
ut[, group := fcase(tier == "elite", "Elite (SIR 2010 / INI)", tier == "central", "Central, non-elite", tier == "state", "State, non-elite", tier == "private", "Private, non-elite",
                    class == "govt_lab_psu", "Government lab / PSU (control)", class == "firm" & !startup, "Domestic firm (control)",
                    class == "firm" & startup, "Startup firm (excluded)", rep(TRUE, .N), class)]
kable(ut[, .(units = .N, filings = sum(n_filings_ever), startups = sum(startup)), by = .(group, ownership)][order(-filings)])
fwrite(ut, here("data", "unit_attributes.csv"))
```

# 10. Panel

Balanced institution x year, `r params$year_min`-`r params$year_max`, domestic units in the three education tiers, government labs / PSUs and firms. Outcome columns: `filings` (by filing year), `granted` and `granted_within_4y` (by filing cohort), `grants_in_year` (patents granted in that year, by grant date), plus early publication, lapse, inventors, co-applicants, foreign priority. Years before a unit's first filing are zeros. Dummies: `treat` (education), `post` (year \>= `r nirf_year`), `treat_post`, `rel_year` (year - `r nirf_year - 1`), `post_fee`. Group columns for the three cuts: `treat`; `ownership` (public / private / firm); `tier` (elite / state / private / govt_lab / firm). `treat` is 0 for both control groups; `class` tells them apart. Elite spans both ownerships, so the ownership cut and the tier cut overlap by design.

```{r panel}
keep_cls <- c("edu_elite", "edu_central", "edu_state", "edu_private", "govt_lab_psu", "firm")
A <- apps[domestic == TRUE & !is.na(inst_id) & class %chin% keep_cls & !is.na(filing_year) & filing_year %in% YEARS]
yr <- A[, .(filings = .N, granted = sum(granted), granted_within_4y = sum(granted_within_4y),
            early_pub = sum(early_pub, na.rm = TRUE), lapsed = sum(lapsed), inventors = sum(n_inventors),
            co_applicant = sum(n_applicants > 1), foreign_priority = sum(!is.na(priority_country) & priority_country != "India")),
        by = .(inst_id, year = filing_year)]
# grants dated by grant year (the e-register date), as a second outcome series: patents obtained in year t, whatever the filing cohort
gy <- apps[domestic == TRUE & !is.na(inst_id) & class %chin% keep_cls & granted & !is.na(grant_date) & year(grant_date) %in% YEARS,
           .(grants_in_year = .N), by = .(inst_id, year = year(grant_date))]
yr <- merge(yr, gy, by = c("inst_id", "year"), all = TRUE)
units <- ut[class %chin% keep_cls, .(inst_id, class, tier, ownership, elite, group, state, startup, first_filing_year)]
panel <- CJ(inst_id = units$inst_id, year = YEARS)
panel <- merge(panel, units, by = "inst_id")
panel <- merge(panel, yr, by = c("inst_id", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
for (v in setdiff(names(yr), c("inst_id", "year"))) set(panel, which(is.na(panel[[v]])), v, 0L)
panel[, treat := as.integer(str_starts(class, "edu_"))]
panel[, post := as.integer(year >= nirf_year)]
panel[, treat_post := treat * post]
panel[, rel_year := year - (nirf_year - 1L)]
panel[, post_fee := as.integer(year > fee_year)]
panel[, filings_complete := year <= pub_complete_year]
panel[, grants_usable := year <= grant_safe_max_year]
setcolorder(panel, c("inst_id", "group", "class", "tier", "ownership", "elite", "state", "startup", "first_filing_year", "year", "rel_year", "treat", "post", "treat_post", "post_fee"))
setorder(panel, inst_id, year)
cat("panel:", nrow(panel), "rows |", uniqueN(panel$inst_id), "units x", length(YEARS), "years | balanced:", panel[, .N, by = inst_id][, uniqueN(N) == 1], "\n")
kable(panel[year <= pub_complete_year, .(units = uniqueN(inst_id), filings = sum(filings), granted_by_cohort = sum(granted), grants_in_year = sum(grants_in_year),
                                         pre_mean = mean(filings[post == 0]), post_mean = mean(filings[post == 1])), by = .(group, ownership)][order(-filings)], digits = 3)
kable(panel[inst_id == panel[ownership == "private"][which.max(filings), inst_id] & year %between% c(2012, 2017),
            .(inst_id, group, year, rel_year, treat, post, treat_post, filings, granted)], caption = "Example rows: largest private university")
kable(panel[inst_id == panel[group == "Domestic firm (control)"][which.max(filings), inst_id] & year %between% c(2012, 2017),
            .(inst_id, group, year, rel_year, treat, post, treat_post, filings, granted)], caption = "Example rows: largest domestic firm")

saveRDS(panel, here("data", "panel_inst_year.rds")); fwrite(panel, here("data", "panel_inst_year.csv.gz"))
slim <- apps[, .(application_number, filing_date, filing_year, publication_date = publication_date_d, grant_date, granted,
                 granted_within_4y, g4_observable, grant_lag_days, pub_lag_days, early_pub, lapsed, priority_country,
                 field_of_invention, ipc_section, classification_ipc, invention_title, n_inventors, n_applicants,
                 applicant1_name, entity, inst_id, sector, class_name, class, tier = inst_tier, ownership = inst_ownership, elite = inst_elite,
                 class_conflict, domestic, app1_state, er_legal_status, er_type_of_application, er_grantee1_grantee_type,
                 rfe_date = as_request_for_examination_date_d, fer_date = as_first_examination_report_date_d,
                 fer_reply_date = as_reply_to_fer_date_d, next_renewal_due = er_due_date_of_next_renewal_d)]
saveRDS(slim, here("data", "applications.rds"))
writeLines(c(paste("built:", Sys.time()), paste("applications:", nrow(apps)), paste("panel units:", uniqueN(panel$inst_id)),
             paste("years:", params$year_min, "-", params$year_max), paste("filings complete through:", pub_complete_year),
             paste("grant outcomes usable through:", grant_safe_max_year), paste("nirf_year:", nirf_year, "| base year:", nirf_year - 1),
             "classification: regex sector + modal sector per name; tier/ownership from R/institution_patterns.csv (SCImago 2010 + manual) and rules; overrides in R/institution_overrides.csv"),
           here("data", "README_panel.txt"))
```

# 11. Simple DiD, three cuts (wiring check only; estimation is in 02_did_nirf.Rmd)

Filings per institution-year, 2005-2020, two-way fixed effects, SE clustered by institution, control = domestic firms minus startups.

```{r did}
if (requireNamespace("fixest", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(fixest)
  d <- panel[year <= 2020 & class %chin% c("edu_elite", "edu_central", "edu_state", "edu_private", "firm") & group != "Startup firm (excluded)"]
  cuts <- list(
    list(level = "1. all", label = "All universities",   sel = quote(treat == 1)),
    list(level = "2. ownership", label = "Central",      sel = quote(treat == 1 & ownership == "central")),
    list(level = "2. ownership", label = "State",        sel = quote(treat == 1 & ownership == "state")),
    list(level = "2. ownership", label = "Private",      sel = quote(treat == 1 & ownership == "private")),
    list(level = "3. capacity", label = "Elite",         sel = quote(elite == 1)),
    list(level = "3. capacity", label = "Non-elite",     sel = quote(treat == 1 & elite == 0)))
  res <- rbindlist(lapply(cuts, function(cc) {
    s <- d[eval(cc$sel) | class == "firm"]
    m <- s[, .(mean = mean(filings)), by = .(treat, post)]
    did22 <- (m[treat == 1 & post == 1, mean] - m[treat == 1 & post == 0, mean]) - (m[treat == 0 & post == 1, mean] - m[treat == 0 & post == 0, mean])
    f <- feols(filings ~ treat_post | inst_id + year, data = s, cluster = ~inst_id)
    data.table(level = cc$level, group = cc$label, n_treated = s[treat == 1, uniqueN(inst_id)], n_control = s[treat == 0, uniqueN(inst_id)],
               treated_pre = m[treat == 1 & post == 0, mean], control_pre = m[treat == 0 & post == 0, mean],
               did_2x2 = did22, twfe = coef(f)[["treat_post"]], se = se(f)[["treat_post"]], p = pvalue(f)[["treat_post"]])
  }))
  res[, stars := fcase(p < 0.001, "***", p < 0.01, "**", p < 0.05, "*", rep(TRUE, .N), "")]
  kable(res, digits = 3)
  fwrite(res, here("output", "did_simple_nirf2015.csv"))
} else cat("fixest not installed; skipping the DiD check\n")
```
